title: Brand asset spec
description: One design direction for a project's wordmark & icons. scripts/build.js turns it into SVGs. Lengths are in em of `size` unless a field says otherwise.

name.description: The project name: the SVG <title> & the alt text.

concept.description: One line on the metaphor, shown on the contact sheet.

file.description: woff2, woff, ttf, or otf; relative to the spec file.

axes.description: Variation settings such as { "wght": 700 }. Axes the font lacks are ignored & reported.

size.description: Font size in pixels of the master drawing.

tracking.description: Extra space between letters, in em.

skew.description: Forward lean in degrees (a fake italic).

padding.description: Space around the drawing, in em.

surfaces.description: Page backgrounds the mark sits on; defaults are the oss-docs-site tokens.

palette.description: Named paints. Each becomes a class in the SVG, so light & dark swap inside one file.

role.description: Sets the contrast target: text 4.5:1, graphic 3:1, decorative reported only.

gradients.description: Gradients across several glyphs, in the drawing's own space so the letters read as one unit.

stops.description: Palette names or literal colours, start to end.

paint.description: Which paint each letter takes. Keys: `*`, a 0-based index, or an inclusive range `4-5`. Values: a palette name or `@gradient`.

motion.description: Speed lines behind the leading letter, right-aligned, inside the x-height band.

gap.description: Space between the lines' right edge & the text.

inset.description: Space above the baseline below the last line.

decorations.description: Extra rectangles relative to the baseline origin (y up is negative), for concept sketches such as a cursor or stripe.

favicon.description: The square icon: one glyph on a tile. Also feeds the touch icon, .ico, & Open Graph image.

glyph.description: Defaults to the first letter of `text`.

tile.description: A palette name, `@gradient`, or literal colour.

ink.description: The glyph colour: a palette name or literal colour.

radius.description: Tile corner radius as a fraction of the tile.

scale.description: Glyph size as a fraction of the tile.

dashes.description: Speed dashes beside the glyph; two survive at 16px, three do not.

url.description: Small line under the tagline, such as the site address without the scheme.

accent.description: Bar along the bottom edge: a palette name, `@gradient`, or literal colour.
